k_justification: Tabular regression with 1,840 rows: gradient-boosted trees are the clear choice; ridge is a near-free reference. The controller adds the mean baseline.

trials.hypothesis: Gradient-boosted trees capture the temperature x catalyst interaction that a linear model misses.
trials.expected_effect: Lower grouped-CV MAE than ridge regression.

trials.hypothesis: A regularized linear model explains most of the variance from dose and temperature.
